split_rule: Sort each task by SHA-256 of its canonical source row. Development uses positions 0:20; three untouched confirmations use 20:40, 40:60, and 60:80. Positions 80:100 remain unused.
memory_selection: For the queried person, retain the most recent K ownership-changing events, including pickup, drop, give, hand, and pass. K grows 1, 2, 6 with Foundation scale. Writes and retrieval never inspect the reference target.
primary_metric: Exact task-balanced accuracy and paired ASCENT-minus-Foundation gain over official BABILong QA7/QA8.
ceiling_aware_secondary_metric: Remaining-error elimination (ASCENT minus Foundation) divided by (1 minus Foundation), reported with the absolute gain and never used to claim accuracy above 100%.
development_gate: Parser accuracy and provenance must pass; every diagonal absolute gain, both adjacent gain increments, and the log-parameter gain slope must be strictly positive. Development is not confirmatory evidence.
confirmation_gate: Across all three untouched panels: every panel is strictly monotone; all three mean gains, both adjacent mean increments, and the log-parameter slope have positive two-sided 95% panel-clustered Student-t lower bounds (df=2).
frozen_controls_after_primary_confirmati: one relevant fact slot at every model scale
truncation_disclosure: Report per-arm maximum token length and number of prompts at the 8192-token cap; do not describe capped Foundation inputs as untruncated full 8K context.
interpretation: Prospective mechanism-matched aggregation test. QA4/QA5 were rejected before scoring because their audited one-fact semantics cannot test expanding nonredundant state. FPVM excluded.
